```{r}
print(scatter_plot)
```

## Replacing outliers with NA

```{r}

# Example function to identify and replace outliers with NA
replace_outliers_with_na <- function(df) {
  for (col in names(df)) {
    Q1 <- quantile(df[[col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    Q3 <- quantile(df[[col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    IQR <- Q3 - Q1
    lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
    upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
    df[[col]][df[[col]] < lower_bound | df[[col]] > upper_bound] <- NA
  }
  return(df)
}

# Replace outliers with NA
no_out_reduced_df_1 <- replace_outliers_with_na(reduced_df_1)


boxplot(no_out_reduced_df_1)
```

# Two step transformation of k parameter

```{r}
# Example transformation for your k parameter
transform_to_normal <- function(x) {
  #browser()
  
  # Step 1: Convert to percentile rank
  percentile_rank <- rank(x, ties.method = "average") / (length(x) + 1)
  
  # Step 2: Apply inverse-normal transformation
  normal_transformed <- qnorm(percentile_rank)
  
  return(normal_transformed)
}

k_transformed <- transform_to_normal(reduced_df_1$phys_k)


hist(k_transformed, main = "Transformed k parameter", xlab = "Transformed k")

# Check normality
shapiro.test(k_transformed)


reduced_df_1$k_transformed <- k_transformed
standard_red_df_1$phys_k_transformed <- k_transformed 


```
# Normality test for common tranformations
```{r}
# Function to calculate normality for a given variable and its transformations
test_normality_for_transformations <- function(variable) {
  # List of transformations to apply
  transformations <- list(
    log = log(variable),
    exp = exp(variable),
    reciprocal = 1 / variable,
    sqrt = sqrt(variable)
  )
  
  # Function to test normality for each transformation
  normality_tests <- function(x, name) {
    cat("\n--- Normality tests for", name, "---\n")
    
    # Shapiro-Wilk test (recommended for small samples)
    shapiro_test <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(x), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(shapiro_test)) {
      cat("Shapiro-Wilk p-value:", shapiro_test$p.value, "\n")
    } else {
      cat("Shapiro-Wilk test failed (possible Inf or NaN values)\n")
    }
    
    # Kolmogorov-Smirnov test against normal distribution
    ks_test <- ks.test(x, "pnorm", mean = mean(x), sd = sd(x))
    cat("Kolmogorov-Smirnov p-value:", ks_test$p.value, "\n")
    
    # Histogram
    hist(x, main = paste("Histogram of", name), col = "lightblue", border = "black", xlab = name)
  }
  
  # Apply normality tests to each transformation
  for (name in names(transformations)) {
    normality_tests(transformations[[name]], name)
  }
}

# Example: Replace `eps` with your variable of interest
# eps <- your_variable_name_here
# Test normality for the `eps` variable (or any other variable you want to analyze)

test_normality_for_transformations(sem_reduced_df_2$gng_eps)


```

```{r}
full_model_day1 <- '

  Vigor =~ foraging_exit_threshold + phys_beta + k_transformed + phys_g
  RL =~ rlwm_alpha + rlwm_bias + rlwm_decay + rlwm_lapse + rlwm_rho + 
        gng_alpha + gng_beta + gng_lapse
  
  # Correlation between latent variables
  Vigor ~~ RL
'

fit_day1 <- sem(model_day1_eps, data = scale(df_1), estimator = "ML")


# Summarize the results for Day 1
summary(fit_day1, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = FALSE, rsquare = TRUE)

# Plot the measurement model for Day 1
lavaanPlot(fit_day1, coefs = TRUE, stand = FALSE, covs = TRUE, stars = c("latent","covs"),graph_options = list(rankdir = "TB"))

# Investigate the goodness of fit
interpret(fit_day1)

# Print the residual matrix
residuals(fit_day1, type="standardized")

# Print the modification indices
modindices(fit_day1)
```

# Two step transformation of k parameter

```{r}
# Example transformation for your k parameter
transform_to_normal <- function(x) {
  # browser()
  
  # Step 1: Convert to percentile rank
  percentile_rank <- rank(x, ties.method = "average") / (length(x) + 1)
  
  # Step 2: Apply inverse-normal transformation
  normal_transformed <- qnorm(percentile_rank)
  
  return(normal_transformed)
}

k_transformed <- transform_to_normal(reduced_df_2$phys_k)


hist(k_transformed, main = "Transformed k parameter", xlab = "Transformed k")

# Check normality
shapiro.test(k_transformed)


reduced_df_2$k_transformed <- k_transformed
standard_red_df_2$phys_k_transformed <- k_transformed 
```

```{r}
sim_data <- simulateData(model_day2, sample.nobs = 80)

fit_sim <- sem(model_day2, data = sim_data, estimator = "MLR")
summary(fit_sim)

# Investigate the goodness of fit
interpret(fit_sim)

lavaanPlot(fit_sim, coefs = TRUE, stand = FALSE, covs = TRUE, stars = c("latent","covs"),graph_options = list(rankdir = "TB"))
```

```{r,eval=FALSE}
longi_model_full <- '

    # Measurement model for Day 1
    RL_day1 =~ a*rlwm_alpha_day1 + b*rlwm_rho_day1 + c*rlwm_bias_day1 + d*rlwm_decay_day1 +e*gng_alpha_rew_day1 + f*gng_eps_rew_day1
  Vigor_day1 =~ g*frgng_exit_day1 + h*phys_k_day1 + i*gng_eps_rew_day1

  # Measurement model for Day 2
  RL_day2 =~ a*rlwm_alpha_day2 + b*rlwm_rho_day2 +   c*rlwm_bias_day2 + d*rlwm_decay_day2 + e*gng_alpha_rew_day2 + f*gng_eps_rew_day2
  Vigor_day2 =~ g*frgng_exit_day2 + h*phys_k_day2 + i*gng_eps_rew_day2

  
  #rlwm_alpha ~~ rlwm_decay
  #rlwm_bias	~~ rlwm_decay
  #gng_alpha_rew	~~ gng_eps_rew
  #rlwm_alpha ~~ rlwm_bias
  # rlwm_rho ~~ rlwm_bias
  #rlwm_alpha ~~ rlwm_rho
 

  
  # Autoregressive paths
  RL_day1 ~ 1*RL_day2
  Vigor_day1 ~ 1*Vigor_day2
  
  RL_day1 ~~ Vigor_day1
  RL_day2 ~~ Vigor_day2

  D1 =~ RL_day1 + Vigor_day1
  D2 =~ RL_day2 + Vigor_day2
  
'
fit_longi_full <- sem(longi_model_full, data = completed_data_full, estimator = "MLR")
summary(fit_longi_full, standardized = TRUE)

# Investigate the goodness of fit
interpret(fit_longi_full)

# Print the residual matrix
residuals(fit_longi_full, type="standardized")

# Print the modification indices
modindices(fit_longi_full)
```

```{r,eval=FALSE}
Vigor_day1 ~ Vigor_day2

D =~ Vigor_day2

'
```
